Interface ClientCallbackRemote

All Superinterfaces:
Remote
All Known Implementing Classes:
ClientCallbackImpl
public interface ClientCallbackRemote extends Remote
RMI callback exported by the client and invoked by the server to push messages to it (the RMI counterpart of the socket ServerMessage stream). The server issues these calls serially per client through RmiVirtualView's single-thread sender, so a client never sees overlapping callbacks.
